candidate_definition.behavior: For each of exactly eight original float64 preactivations: finite guard, binary64 clamp to [-35,35], correctly rounded candidate cr_exp(-u), binary64 denominator 1.0 + result, and binary64 numerator reciprocal 1.0 / denominator. Reproduce original operation order and record every stage's uint64 IEEE-754 bytes.
candidate_definition.environment: Declare rounding mode FE_TONEAREST, 64-bit binary64 intermediates, explicit FMA/FP contraction behavior, no fast-math, no architecture-adaptive source alteration and no silent runtime fallback.
candidate_definition.numeric_oracle: Original MR34I4 Decimal80 plus MR34I8 Decimal120 outputs; compare raw binary64 representation, not rounded printed decimals.
candidate_definition.original_control: Original NumPy p=1./(1.+np.exp(-np.clip(u,-35.,35.))) eight-wide unchanged; preserve its exact execution context.
candidate_definition.public_abi: void candidate_sigmoid8(const double input_u[8], double output_p[8]);
candidate_definition.source_mutation: None to original S4C1, Farama, Pycolab, installed runtime, 45 weights, BPTT, Adam or native snapshots.

frozen_proposed_acceptance.cpu: For every worker the median actual per-eight-wide-call inclusive process CPU for candidate <= original NumPy under matched five-pair ABBA comparisons; any regression means RESOURCE_NO_GO.
frozen_proposed_acceptance.memory: Matched candidate process-tree peak resident bytes <= original baseline process-tree peak resident bytes; any regression means RESOURCE_NO_GO; retain actual source actor and native learner costs separately.
frozen_proposed_acceptance.numeric: All 490 candidate binary64 sigmoid outputs are bitwise equal across the four workers; each output within <=1 ULP of Decimal120 reference; original NumPy disagreements must be reported without correction.
frozen_proposed_acceptance.repeat_control: One fixed four-worker qualification; an infrastructure-failed run may be independently diagnosed, but never omit a completed unfavorable result or choose the best runner.
frozen_proposed_acceptance.semantic_scope: ENGINEERING_KERNEL_ONLY. Never admit S4C1 40-epoch trained checkpoint, unfamiliar transfer or protected scientific first-use based on the kernel.
frozen_proposed_acceptance.source: All four workers' model and external source exact immutable identities PASS; all 490 original input values match the previously frozen source-derived bytes.

intent: One bounded development-only falsification of a compiled deterministic exponential-based sigmoid kernel against the original unchanged NumPy eight-wide sigmoid, before any 45-weight S4C1 training or protected third-source scientific evaluation.

measurement.bench_interface: Call the candidate through the actual proposed Python/C ABI on identical eight-wide arrays; do not benchmark one bulk C call against repeated eight-wide NumPy calls if actual integration would incur per-call overhead.
measurement.ci_matrix: windows-latest x2, ubuntu-latest x2; separately log exact resolved runner image and toolchain identity
measurement.microbenchmark: 3 untimed warmups; 256 timed repetitions of the exact four input cohorts in fixed source order, retaining cohort count and total 490 values; baseline/candidate in balanced ABBA order with five full paired rounds per host
measurement.preflight: Clean exact commit/tree SHA for all sources and strictly identical original input SHA per frozen cohort; reject any upstream actor/logit drift before benchmarking
measurement.repeatability: Recompute identical original input and candidate output raw hashes within each worker; confirm identical bits across all four jobs and within same OS replicas.
measurement.resources: Measure both matched isolated process configurations (original-only and candidate-loaded), CPU, wall, process-tree peak resident memory and candidate .so/.dll bytes with source collection cost clearly separated. Include communication/FFI costs for actual proposed interface.
measurement.timing: Use aggregate process CPU ns for each full paired round; preserve individual raw records, balanced-order medians, and aggregate wall ns as secondary metric. Reject zero aggregate CPU durations or corrupt runs without selecting a favorable rerun.

next_if_fail: Close current high-precision sigmoid replacement search as a resource or numerical negative; continue causal-information, local specialization and transferable-memory research without opening unfamiliar scientific first-use.
next_if_pass: A SEPARATE preregistered MR34I10 tests original 45-parameter S4C1 forward/backward, first-gradient parity and cross-OS 40-epoch final checkpoint byte identity with equally informed trained controls, all-in CPU/RSS/storage and unchanged first-use custody.

original_development_inputs.first_use: Previously consumed original S4C1 development TRAINING episodes only; no held or protected independent source.

preimplementation_acceptance_notes.bench_cpu: Require positive aggregate process CPU over matched trials; user-space FFI and library loading are counted in relevant operation costs
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.freeze_boundary: First authorized git commit contains only this reviewed protocol and independent toolchain lock. Implementation, generated binary and workflow MUST occur in later bounded commits.
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.memory: Strict no-increase RSS budget is potentially difficult for a dynamic library: retain it exactly as preregistered, report FAIL if exceeded rather than retroactively relaxing.
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.numerical_environment: Check FE_TONEAREST at runtime, finite inputs, no altered clipping/order, no silent fallback, and non-overlapping input/output buffers unless explicitly supported by ABI
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.reference_semantics: cr_exp correctly rounded exp on binary64 is not a proof that the composed 1/(1+exp(-u)) equals the high-precision sigmoid after intermediate rounding. Keep <=1 ULP frozen tolerance.
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.separate_integration: Original G29 indexed-file-set fail-closed remains a separate independent integration gate even when the kernel microbenchmark passes.
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.source-firstuse: Only original consumed development input suite; do not open independent third-source or any protected held test.
preimplementation_acceptance_notes.stop_policy: A compiler incompatibility or cross-OS output mismatch is a failed bounded gate unless demonstrably mechanical pre-measurement failure qualifies for separately frozen repair; never alter numerical acceptance post-result.

required_workflow: Through existing authorized CKB-plane engineering/qualification authority only: source-only protocol first commit -> clean exact source qualification checkout -> bounded implementation -> focused tests -> one full final regression -> build -> guarded engineering acceptance if separately authorized. No direct repo mutation or run was performed by this chat.
